name: veda
description: Veda: generic, public tooling for repositories that coding agents work in. Nothing is published under this name; each package under packages/ is.

scripts.check: pnpm -r check && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm lint && pnpm guards
scripts.guards: node scripts/released-pins.mjs && pariksha boundary && pariksha required-settings --require .veda/required-settings.json && pariksha required-settings --require node_modules/@veda-hq/pariksha/baselines/claude-settings.json && sarathi check --settings .claude/settings.json
